---
title: "Helper Page: CDS API Access"
format: html
---


Before downloading ERA5 data, the operator must have access to the Copernicus
Climate Data Store.

Use this helper page to establish the shared authentication state required by
the download pages:

- create or confirm a CDS account;
- store the API key in `~/.cdsapirc` using the institution's credential policy;
- run the `cdsapi` authentication check.

Record the credential location and authentication result before continuing.
